To help reproduce your issue, could you provide the following details?
- What did you expect to see?
- System information (OS, environment, etc.)
- Prometheus version
- Prometheus configuration file

This information will help the maintainers understand and address your problem.

labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The report is missing required information: expected behavior, system info, Prometheus version, config.
